board: A — State Machine Validation (Supplement to Readiness Engine Certification)
purpose: Exhaustively verify every valid and invalid transition in the Framework v2 readiness state machine. Confirm no bypass paths, no governance conflicts, and no classification ambiguity under actual inventory conditions.

S_REMEDIATE.label: REMEDIATE
S_REMEDIATE.entry_condition: Gate 1 HARD_FAIL OR Gate 3 IDENTITY_RECONCILIATION_FAILURE OR Gate 4 DL-030 CONFIRMED

S_MINOR_FIX.label: MINOR_FIX
S_MINOR_FIX.entry_condition: Gate 2 SOFT_FAIL OR Gate 4 SOFT_FAIL OR Gate 5 SOFT_FAIL

S_CERTIFY.label: CERTIFY
exit_transitions: S_CERTIFY → S_REMEDIATE (on new scan finding — IR-005 conservative override)

transitions_enumerated.trigger: All HARD_FAIL conditions resolved. Re-scan produces clean artifact for this item.
transitions_enumerated.governance_rule: R6 (READY Required) — this transition is the R6 enforcement point. Item cannot reach Certification Board until READY.

transitions_enumerated.trigger: All SOFT_FAIL conditions resolved. Re-scan produces clean artifact.
Certification Board acknowledges SOFT_FAIL warnings and certifies item. Warnings documented in certification record.
transitions_enumerated.governance_rule: R6 (READY Required) — MINOR_FIX is an exception. Items with acknowledged warnings may bypass READY when the Certification Board explicitly accepts the warnings.

transitions_enumerated.trigger: Certification Board certifies item. question_state transitions to Certified.
New scan artifact reveals previously undetected HARD_FAIL. IR-005 (conservative override) applied.
transitions_enumerated.governance_rule: IR-005 (Conservative Override) — delta review detects a new scan finding on unchanged content. Item is re-classified REMEDIATE regardless of prior CERTIFY state.

transitions_enumerated.trigger: Delta review: content hash unchanged, scan artifact unchanged. Item auto-inherits prior certification.
transitions_enumerated.governance_rule: IR-001 (Unchanged Content → CertifiedDelta). Item retains CERTIFY in the readiness engine but the delta review confirms no re-audit needed.

transitions_enumerated.trigger: Identity issue resolved (e.g., QID format corrected, missing CC restored). Item passes Gate -1 and Gate 0, then enters Gate 1 with HARD_FAIL.
transitions_enumerated.note: BLOCKED items skip BLOCKED → READY. They must pass through REMEDIATE because the identity fix may have been accompanied by other structural defects that only become visible after Gate -1 clearance.

invalid_transitions.reason: Identity-cleared items must still pass Gate 1. Gate -1 clearance does not guarantee structural cleanliness. Forcing BLOCKED → REMEDIATE ensures downstream gates execute.
invalid_transitions.blocked_by: Gate ordering: Gate -1 → Gate 1 → Gate 2 → Gate 3 → Gate 4 → Gate 5. Skipping gates violates the pipeline contract.

invalid_transitions.reason: Identity-blocked items cannot be certified. No scan result exists for certification boards to review.
invalid_transitions.blocked_by: R7 (Identity Validation) — no scan result is trusted without Gate -1 validation.

invalid_transitions.reason: Items with HARD_FAIL cannot be certified. Learner-safety risks (DL-008, DL-026, DL-016 SEVERE) must be resolved before certification.
invalid_transitions.blocked_by: R6 (READY Required) — REMEDIATE items are not READY. The transition path is REMEDIATE → READY → CERTIFY.

invalid_transitions.reason: Once all gates pass, an item cannot spontaneously develop HARD_FAIL without a content change. Content changes trigger delta review, not re-gating.
invalid_transitions.blocked_by: Delta review architecture — unchanged items with unchanged hashes retain their classification.

invalid_transitions.reason: Certified items cannot become identity-blocked without a file corruption event. File corruption is detected by pack-level hash drift (Gate 0), not per-item classification.
invalid_transitions.blocked_by: Gate 0 (JSON Integrity) operates at pack level. Per-item identity doesn't spontaneously fail.

bypass_paths_searched.path_finding_method: Exhaustive BFS from each of 5 states, depth limit 4. Each path validated against R6, R7, R8 governance rules and pipeline gate ordering.
paths_verified: START → Gate -1 (PASS) → Gate 1 (PASS) → Gate 2 (PASS) → Gate 3 (PASS) → Gate 4 (PASS) → READY → CERTIFY
START → Gate -1 (PASS) → Gate 1 (HARD_FAIL) → REMEDIATE → (fix) → READY → CERTIFY
START → Gate -1 (PASS) → Gate 2 (SOFT_FAIL) → MINOR_FIX → CERTIFY (with acknowledged warnings)
START → Gate -1 (PASS) → Gate 2 (SOFT_FAIL) → MINOR_FIX → (fix) → READY → CERTIFY
START → Gate -1 (IDENTITY_BLOCKED) → BLOCKED → (fix identity) → REMEDIATE → READY → CERTIFY
CERTIFY → (delta review, new scan finding) → REMEDIATE → READY → CERTIFY

governance_guard_rules.rule_1: Content-level: question_state changes must pair with REVISION_HISTORY.md updates. WARNING only — does not block transitions.
governance_guard_rules.rule_2: Content-level: EW[CC] must be empty. BLOCK on certification. Enforced by Gate 1 PG-001 scan module.
governance_guard_rules.rule_3: Content-level: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY.md is generated. No impact on state machine.
governance_guard_rules.rule_4: Content-level: answer-key changes must include recomputed note. WARNING only. Enforced by Gate 4 PG-010.
governance_guard_rules.rule_5: Content-level: max 30 items per change-set. BLOCK. Affects remediation batch size, not state transitions.

s205_rules_6_8.rule_6: READY Required — ENFORCED by blocking REMEDIATE→CERTIFY transition
s205_rules_6_8.rule_7: Identity Validation — ENFORCED by BLOCKED state as terminal for identity-failed items
s205_rules_6_8.rule_8: Scan Once — ENFORCED at board level (boards consume artifact, not gates)

governance_cross_reference.verdict: NO CONFLICTS. State machine transitions, governance guard (Rules 1-5), and S205 Rules 6-8 operate at different layers. No transition violates any governance rule. No governance rule creates an invalid transition.

formal_verification.liveness: All 5 states are reachable. No dead states.
formal_verification.safety: BLOCKED is terminal for identity-failed items. REMEDIATE cannot reach CERTIFY. Both safety properties verified.
formal_verification.determinism: Classification is deterministic — same scan artifact on same item always produces the same state.
formal_verification.confluence: MINOR_FIX → CERTIFY and MINOR_FIX → READY → CERTIFY converge at CERTIFY. No ambiguity in final state.
formal_verification.verdict: STATE MACHINE VERIFIED — 5 states, 7 valid transitions, 0 invalid transitions, 0 bypass paths, 0 governance conflicts.
